run_check_atomic_fact: run check_atomic_fact to verify if a given atomic fact is supported by searching and reasoning
run_call_search: run call_search to execute a Google search query via Serper API and return results
run_maybe_get_next_search: run maybe_get_next_search to generate a search query from a model based on an atomic fact and past searches
run_maybe_get_final_answer: run maybe_get_final_answer to determine if an atomic fact is supported or not supported by accumulated knowledge
review_google_search_result: review the GoogleSearchResult dataclass that stores a search query and its result string
